glossary.definition: (1) "Farm machinery" has the same meaning as in section 4501.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5577.042 - Weight provisions for farm, log and coal trucks and farm machinery.

glossary.definition: (2) "Farm commodities" includes livestock, bulk milk, corn, soybeans, tobacco, and wheat.
glossary.source_title: Section 5577.042 - Weight provisions for farm, log and coal trucks and farm machinery.

glossary.definition: (3) "Farm truck" means a truck used in the transportation from a farm of farm commodities when the truck is operated in accordance with this section.
glossary.source_title: Section 5577.042 - Weight provisions for farm, log and coal trucks and farm machinery.

glossary.definition: (4) "Log truck" means a truck used in the transportation of timber from the site of its cutting when the truck is operated in accordance with this section.
glossary.source_title: Section 5577.042 - Weight provisions for farm, log and coal trucks and farm machinery.

glossary.definition: (5) "Coal truck" means a truck transporting coal from the site where it is mined when the truck is operated in accordance with this section.
glossary.source_title: Section 5577.042 - Weight provisions for farm, log and coal trucks and farm machinery.

glossary.definition: (6) "Solid waste" has the same meaning as in section 3734.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5577.042 - Weight provisions for farm, log and coal trucks and farm machinery.
